HDFC Bank Legal Review Finds Former Chairman's Charges Unsubstantiated

HDFC Bank announced that a legal review has concluded that charges made by its former chairman were not substantiated. Both Business Standard and The Times of India reported on this development. The review's findings indicate a lack of evidence to support the allegations previously raised.
